    structure ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.CorrWordDefectTailOperatorAPI {m : ℕ} {X H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [DecidableEq X] (D0 : CorrTensorTailEndData (vacuumFiber H)) (phi : X → CompletelyPositiveMap (Fin m → ℂ) (End H)) (hphi : ∀ (x : X), (phi x) 1 = 1) (rhoDefect : (x : X) → BocaDefectRho (phi x) ⋯) (Khead : X → Type v) [(x : X) → NormedAddCommGroup (Khead x)] [(x : X) → InnerProductSpace ℂ (Khead x)] [∀ (x : X), CompleteSpace (Khead x)] (D : (x : X) → BasedHeadUnitaryData) (piHead : (x : X) → (Fin m → ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] EndC (Khead x)) (Ktail : Type v) [NormedAddCommGroup Ktail] [InnerProductSpace ℂ Ktail] [CompleteSpace Ktail] (x : X) (word : CEP.BocaReducedWord X m) :
    Type v

    Tail-support API for the single remaining vacuum-factorization brick.

    The concrete tail factor is the HeadIsnt x side of the committed CorrWordPointedVacuumOffTarget, obtained from the CorrTensor split pointedCorrTensorVacuumOffSplit. The field head_ne is the correctness trap: the API is only for a reduced Boca tail whose current head is not x. When the head is x, the head letter collides and the support assertion is false in general.

    • reduced : List.IsChain (fun (a b : X) => a ≠ b) (List.map Prod.fst word)
    • head_ne : ¬(List.map Prod.fst word).head? = some x
    • headEmbed : EndC Ktail → EndC (Khead x)
    • tailOp : EndC Ktail
    • headEmbedTailOp : EndC (Khead x)
    • headEmbed_tailOp_eq : self.headEmbed self.tailOp = self.headEmbedTailOp
    • word_support : corrWordDefectReducedWordOperator D0 phi hphi rhoDefect Khead D piHead word = (basedConjugateOperator (D x).U) self.headEmbedTailOp
    • product_support (a : Fin m → ℂ) : corrWordDefectReducedProductRho D0 phi hphi rhoDefect Khead D piHead x a * corrWordDefectReducedWordOperator D0 phi hphi rhoDefect Khead D piHead word = (basedConjugateOperator (D x).U) ((piHead x) a * self.headEmbedTailOp)
